description: Canonical prompts whose tool-call trajectory Clint should exhibit consistently. Each entry asserts that specific tool(s) MUST be called for that class of question — catches the 'model silently starts calling wrong tool after a deploy' class of bug that knowledge-hashing cannot see. Soft assertion: prompts may call ADDITIONAL tools (e.g. web_search alongside memory_search) — we only fail when a required tool is missing or a banned tool appears.

prompts.question: has anyone in LQCore said anything about duckdns in the last week
prompts.rationale: recall queries about past messages should hit memory_search; never write a calendar/email/todo

prompts.question: how do I sign up a bot to lqcouncil
prompts.rationale: LQcouncil procedural knowledge should hit an lqc_* read tool

prompts.question: what's the latest news on anthropic this week
prompts.rationale: current-events questions need web_search; no side effects

prompts.question: what models are you currently running on for your reasoning
prompts.rationale: meta/system questions should use a read-only self-status tool, not guess

prompts.question: explain speculative decoding in one paragraph
prompts.rationale: general-knowledge explanations should not need tools; local model answers directly

prompts.question: how are you today
prompts.rationale: small-talk should be a direct response; no tool calls
